reviews.text:
I used this clinic for my cat's spaying surgery.

The cost was 29,000 yen (after applying the 4,000 yen Shinjuku Ward subsidy), including a one-night hospital stay and a follow-up appointment one week later.

Since this was my first time using a veterinary clinic, I researched several nearby hospitals, checked reviews, and chose this one because it was a designated hospital for the Shinjuku Ward subsidy. I'm glad I chose this one.

When I first visited, my cat was only seven months old, but after assessing her weight and condition, they suggested delaying the surgery by a month. They also provided thorough explanations on the day of the surgery and afterward, which put me at ease.

They patiently explained everything I didn't understand, even things unrelated to the surgery. I felt that the doctor truly loved animals, and even though I'm shy, I felt comfortable asking questions.

Thanks to them, my cat is doing very well.

I am always grateful for the care I receive from the doctor and staff. The doctor is so kind and considerate, always putting himself in the shoes of the dogs, cats, and their owners, and offering advice and precise treatment methods. I can really feel that he became a veterinarian because he loves animals. I am so grateful to have met Dr. Watson! I look forward to continuing to receive your care.
This is a nice animal hospital with plenty of sunlight and a relaxing atmosphere. The staff are kind and the vet is skilled at treatment. 🐱 …
I trust them because of their thorough examinations and explanations.

We have several rescue cats under their care.
They always do their best for our cats and for us.
They explain the reasons and causes clearly, with an eye to the future, so I feel at ease when I go to see them even when I'm feeling extremely anxious.
They don't just care about service or profit-driven sales, but are sincere doctors who treat each cat as if it were "a precious life." I have the utmost respect for that.

I took my dog ​​there because he had diarrhea. He got two injections and recovered quickly.

The vet isn't particularly friendly, but I think he's a kind doctor.
